resume: Small minimalist ensemble in the spirit of Philip Glass: it plays by itself from power-up, then you take over. In EASY mode, each white key is a chord that fits. Four models and twenty pieces.

commandes.role: Lowers the octave of the upper part.
Raises the octave of the upper part.
Chords page. With SEL held, brings the part in or out.
Held, switches to hand playing: ENV, ARP, LFO, SEQ and FX bring a part in or out, EDIT goes back to the previous idea, REC learns a cycle, PLAY alternates songs and live.
Draws an idea for the displayed page; with SEL, goes back to the previous idea.
Setup page; a second press opens System.
Form page; held with SELECT, sets the tempo.
Saves pieces and songs; held, resets the piece to its recipe (in SONGS, deletes the song).
Records a song from the start; a second press keeps it.
Previous or next page; with HOME held, sets the tempo.
Selects the piece (twenty), or the song (eight) in SONGS.
Selects the chord cycle (eighteen, Mine, Rolled).
Play the chord. In EASY, each white key is a chord of the key (tonic on the left), the black keys the same with a seventh; in NOTES, they are the notes.

gestes: SEL + EDIT: goes back to the previous idea.
SEL + REC: learns a chord cycle (two to eight chords, then REC) which becomes Mine.
SEL + white keys 1 to 8: grow, shrink, shift, flip, freeze, slow down, speed up, new section.

modes.texte: ARPEGGIO, PHASE, PATTERNS and BELLS, chosen on the System page (Model). Each has its own pieces.
